_comment: Curated profile copy. Edit this file to change how the site and README describe you; the daily Action re-renders both. Dates are YYYY-MM. Keep 'highlights' to real, verifiable items.
headline: Building agentic AI and mobile apps
role: Team Lead, Medscape AI & Professional Apps · WebMD · Navi Mumbai
tagline: I lead the Medscape AI and professional apps team at WebMD, ship Android and iOS apps, build agentic AI and developer tooling, and rebuild my stack whenever something better lands.
summary: Most of my time now goes to the edge of what AI makes possible: agent-driven software lifecycles, MCP servers, LLM-powered apps, and speech pipelines that run on the device instead of in someone else's cloud. Underneath is nine years of Android, from a first developer job in 2017 to leading a team at WebMD, and lately iOS.

focus.title: AI-native development
focus.blurb: Agent-driven SDLC experiments, MCP servers, LLM chat and agent apps. Claude, Gemini, Qwen and local models are part of the daily toolchain, not a demo.

focus.title: Mobile, end to end
focus.blurb: Android with Jetpack Compose, iOS with SwiftUI, shared logic with Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter when it fits. Clean architecture that survives feature growth.

focus.title: Voice & on-device AI
focus.blurb: Streaming speech recognition, language models and neural text-to-speech stitched into private, low-latency pipelines: Whisper, Parakeet, Kokoro, LiveKit, WebRTC.

focus.title: Latest tech, hands-on
focus.blurb: Three.js simulators, real-time WebRTC agents, FastAPI services and self-hosted models. If it shipped this year, there is probably a repo here trying it.
